notes.title: 🚨 Search and Rescue — Major Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
🚨 Search and Rescue — Major Update Incoming!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42008029/d832a6394d6817483866b9a27405df86ccff104a.jpg"]

Get ready for a major evolution of Search and Rescue!
Based on your reviews and feedback, this update is a huge step forward — a complete refresh of the game’s pacing, look, and feel.

🔧 Dozens of improvements across gameplay, visuals, tech, and UI
🧭 Less luck-based, more control through planning and decision-making
⚡ Faster-paced and more dynamic missions
🎨 Enhanced animations and a cleaner, updated visual style
🎯 Tighter game mechanics for a more engaging experience
🔥 Increased challenge — missions now require more focus and thoughtful planning to succeed!


This is a new approach to Search and Rescue — more immersive, more tactical, and more rewarding.

🟢 Wishlist or jump back in
🟢 Invite friends and family to the co-op adventure
🟢 Leave a review and share your ideas — all constructive feedback is welcome!

The more, the merrier. See you on the trails, rescuers! 🚁🌲
